Before making such a big decision, it can be helpful to talk to someone you trust about your thoughts and feelings. This could be a friend, family member, therapist, or support group.

Consider your options
There are several options you can consider if you are considering leaving your husband. You could try counseling or couples therapy to see if you can work through your issues and repair the relationship. You could also consider a trial separation to see if you can live apart and work things out. If you decide to end the marriage, you could get a divorce, which has legal consequences, or you could separate and live apart, which would not have any legal consequences.

Plan ahead
If you decide to leave your husband, it is important to plan ahead. This includes getting legal advice about your options and rights, finding a place to live, and making plans for any children you have.

Take care of yourself
Ending a marriage can be emotionally and physically draining. Practice self-care by eating well, getting enough sleep, and finding healthy ways to cope with stress.
